latHint: Think a gloomy poem that keeps saying 'Nevermore.'
pivHint: A ROOK is the castle-shaped chess piece. It is also a black bird of the crow family, a cousin of the crow and the ______.
winText: Nevermore lost. ROOK was the pivot - a chess castle to a fellow black bird, the RAVEN.
lossText: RAVEN - a large black bird of the crow family. ROOK was the pivot: a ROOK is a chess piece, but a ROOK is also a black bird in the same family as the RAVEN.
